fullText.simplified:
四、我好像说错话了

    数字人住在网络里，如果人类不打开对视器，数字人是不能出来和人类说话的。所以多多很少关对视器，有时候还会带我出门，她喜欢带我看外面的世界。
    “爸爸，你看，这些苹果真红，我们买几个，好不好？”
    “爸爸，那只小狗真漂亮，你看到了吗？”
    她喜欢问我问题，但有时候她说得太快，我还没有回答，她就问了第二个问题。有时候她又说得很慢，我已经回答了，但她好像没听到，要等很长时间才会再和我说话。慢慢地我明白了，她不是真的在问我问题，她只是需要一个能真正陪伴她的人。
    有一天，多多带我去了沉睡中心。
    我看着沉睡中的自己，觉得奇怪极了，就像我和我的身体分开了。看了一会儿后，又觉得这个沉睡的人好奇怪，他好像是我，但又不是我。
    多多看着沉睡中的我，眼睛里好像有很多话要说，但是她没有说。
    回家的路上，多多还是不说话。我想办法让她说话。
    “多多，别难过，爸爸爱你，爸爸在你身边。”
    “多多，你今天还没有吃东西，去吃你喜欢的蛋包饭吧！”
    “多多，家里没有牛奶了，我们去买点儿牛奶吧！就买你最喜欢的香蕉牛奶。”
    “多多，今天晚上有音乐会，我们去听音乐会吧！”
    ……
    我一直说话，希望多多也说话，但是多多好像不愿意听我说话。她有点儿生气，对我叫：“不要说了，不要说了！”这是她第一次对成为数字人的我生气，我不明白她为什么生气，但网络数据告诉了我应该怎么办。
    “对不起，多多。”
    “爸爸，你为什么说对不起？”
    “我好像说错话了。”
    “爸爸，你说错什么了？”
    “我不知道。对不起。”
    多多哭了，她看起来难过极了。
    “对不起，多多，我爱你。”
    多多不说话了，她关掉了对视器。
fullText.traditional:
四、我好像說錯話了

    數字人住在網絡裡，如果人類不打開對視器，數字人是不能出來和人類說話的。所以多多很少關對視器，有時候還會帶我出門，她喜歡帶我看外面的世界。
    “爸爸，你看，這些蘋果真紅，我們買幾個，好不好？”
    “爸爸，那隻小狗真漂亮，你看到了嗎？”
    她喜歡問我問題，但有時候她說得太快，我還沒有回答，她就問了第二個問題。有時候她又說得很慢，我已經回答了，但她好像沒聽到，要等很長時間才會再和我說話。慢慢地我明白了，她不是真的在問我問題，她只是需要一個能真正陪伴她的人。
    有一天，多多帶我去了沉睡中心。
    我看著沉睡中的自己，覺得奇怪極了，就像我和我的身體分開了。看了一會兒後，又覺得這個沉睡的人好奇怪，他好像是我，但又不是我。
    多多看著沉睡中的我，眼睛裡好像有很多話要說，但是她沒有說。
    回家的路上，多多還是不說話。我想辦法讓她說話。
    “多多，別難過，爸爸愛你，爸爸在你身邊。”
    “多多，你今天還沒有吃東西，去吃你喜歡的蛋包飯吧！”
    “多多，家裡沒有牛奶了，我們去買點兒牛奶吧！就買你最喜歡的香蕉牛奶。”
    “多多，今天晚上有音樂會，我們去聽音樂會吧！”
    ……
    我一直說話，希望多多也說話，但是多多好像不願意聽我說話。她有點兒生氣，對我叫：“不要說了，不要說了！”這是她第一次對成為數字人的我生氣，我不明白她為什麼生氣，但網絡數據告訴了我應該怎麼辦。
    “對不起，多多。”
    “爸爸，你為什麼說對不起？”
    “我好像說錯話了。”
    “爸爸，你說錯什麼了？”
    “我不知道。對不起。”
    多多哭了，她看起來難過極了。
    “對不起，多多，我愛你。”
    多多不說話了，她關掉了對視器。

sentences.pinyin: shù zì rén zhù zài wǎng luò lǐ
sentences.english: Digital humans live in the network.

sentences.simplified: 如果人类不打开对视器，数字人是不能出来和人类说话的。
sentences.traditional: 如果人類不打開對視器，數字人是不能出來和人類說話的。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ rén lèi bù dǎ kāi duì shì qì shù zì rén shì bù néng chū lái hé rén lèi shuō huà de
sentences.english: If humans do not turn on the viewing device, digital humans are not able to come out and talk to humans.

sentences.simplified: 所以多多很少关对视器，有时候还会带我出门，她喜欢带我看外面的世界。
sentences.traditional: 所以多多很少關對視器，有時候還會帶我出門，她喜歡帶我看外面的世界。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ duō duō hěn shǎo guān duì shì qì yǒu shí hou hái huì dài wǒ chū mén tā xǐ huan dài wǒ kàn wài miàn de shì jiè
sentences.english: So Duoduo seldom turned off the viewing device. Sometimes, she took me out. She liked to show me the outside world.

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，你看，这些苹果真红，我们买几个，好不好？”
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，你看，這些蘋果真紅，我們買幾個，好不好？”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba nǐ kàn zhè xiē píng guǒ zhēn hóng wǒ men mǎi jǐ ge hǎo bù hǎo
sentences.english: “Dad, look, these apples are so red. Let’s buy some, how about that?”

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，那只小狗真漂亮，你看到了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，那隻小狗真漂亮，你看到了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba nà zhī xiǎo gǒu zhēn piào liang nǐ kàn dào le ma
sentences.english: “Dad, that puppy is so beautiful. Did you see it?”

sentences.simplified: 她喜欢问我问题，但有时候她说得太快，我还没有回答，她就问了第二个问题。
sentences.traditional: 她喜歡問我問題，但有時候她說得太快，我還沒有回答，她就問了第二個問題。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐ huan wèn wǒ wèn tí dàn yǒu shí hou tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ hái méi yǒu huí dá tā jiù wèn le dì èr ge wèn tí
sentences.english: She liked to ask me questions, but sometimes she spoke too fast, and before I could answer, she had asked a second question.

sentences.simplified: 有时候她又说得很慢，我已经回答了，但她好像没听到，
sentences.traditional: 有時候她又說得很慢，我已經回答了，但她好像沒聽到，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou tā yòu shuō de hěn màn wǒ yǐ jīng huí dá le dàn tā hǎo xiàng méi tīng dào
sentences.english: Sometimes, she spoke very slowly, and even though I had already responded, it seemed like she didn’t hear me, ..

sentences.simplified: 要等很长时间才会再和我说话。
sentences.traditional: 要等很長時間才會再和我說話。
sentences.pinyin: yào děng hěn cháng shí jiān cái huì zài hé wǒ shuō huà
sentences.english: .. and I had to wait a long time before she talked to me again.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地我明白了，她不是真的在问我问题，她只是需要一个能真正陪伴她的人。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地我明白了，她不是真的在問我問題，她只是需要一個能真正陪伴她的人。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de wǒ míng bai le tā bú shì zhēn de zài wèn wǒ wèn tí tā zhǐ shì xū yào yí ge néng zhēn zhèng péi bàn tā de rén
sentences.english: Gradually, I understood that she wasn’t really asking me questions. She just needed someone who could truly be there for her.

sentences.simplified: 有一天，多多带我去了沉睡中心。
sentences.traditional: 有一天，多多帶我去了沉睡中心。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān duō duō dài wǒ qù le chén shuì zhōng xīn
sentences.english: Once, Duoduo took me to the deep sleep center.

sentences.simplified: 我看着沉睡中的自己，觉得奇怪极了，就像我和我的身体分开了。
sentences.traditional: 我看著沉睡中的自己，覺得奇怪極了，就像我和我的身體分開了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn zhe chén shuì zhōng de zì jǐ jué de qí guài jí le jiù xiàng wǒ hé wǒ de shēn tǐ fēn kāi le
sentences.english: I looked at myself sleeping and felt very strange, as if I was separated from my body.

sentences.simplified: 看了一会儿后，又觉得这个沉睡的人好奇怪，他好像是我，但又不是我。
sentences.traditional: 看了一會兒後，又覺得這個沉睡的人好奇怪，他好像是我，但又不是我。
sentences.pinyin: kàn le yí huì'r hòu yòu jué de zhè ge chén shuì de rén hǎo qí guài tā hǎo xiàng shì wǒ dàn yòu bú shì wǒ
sentences.english: After watching for a while, I felt that this deep sleeping person was so strange. He seemed to be me, but also not me.

sentences.simplified: 多多看着沉睡中的我，眼睛里好像有很多话要说，但是她没有说。
sentences.traditional: 多多看著沉睡中的我，眼睛裡好像有很多話要說，但是她沒有說。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō kàn zhe chén shuì zhōng de wǒ yǎn jing lǐ hǎo xiàng yǒu hěn duō huà yào shuō dàn shì tā méi yǒu shuō
sentences.english: Duoduo looked at me while I was in deep sleep. Her eyes seemed to have a lot of things she wanted to say, but she didn’t speak.

sentences.simplified: 回家的路上，多多还是不说话。我想办法让她说话。
sentences.traditional: 回家的路上，多多還是不說話。我想辦法讓她說話。
sentences.pinyin: huí jiā de lù shang duō duō hái shi bù shuō huà wǒ xiǎng bàn fǎ ràng tā shuō huà
sentences.english: On the way home, Duoduo still didn’t speak. I tried to get her to talk.

sentences.simplified: “多多，别难过，爸爸爱你，爸爸在你身边。”
sentences.traditional: “多多，別難過，爸爸愛你，爸爸在你身邊。”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō bié nán guò bà ba ài nǐ bà ba zài nǐ shēn biān
sentences.english: “Duoduo, don’t be sad. Dad loves you, and Dad is by your side.”

sentences.simplified: “多多，你今天还没有吃东西，去吃你喜欢的蛋包饭吧！”
sentences.traditional: “多多，你今天還沒有吃東西，去吃你喜歡的蛋包飯吧！”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō nǐ jīn tiān hái méi yǒu chī dōng xi qù chī nǐ xǐ huan de dàn bāo fàn ba
sentences.english: “Duoduo, you haven’t eaten anything today. Go eat the omelet rice that you like!”

sentences.simplified: “多多，家里没有牛奶了，我们去买点儿牛奶吧！就买你最喜欢的香蕉牛奶。”
sentences.traditional: “多多，家裡沒有牛奶了，我們去買點兒牛奶吧！就買你最喜歡的香蕉牛奶。”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō jiā lǐ méi yǒu niú nǎi le wǒ men qù mǎi diǎn'r niú nǎi ba jiù mǎi nǐ zuì xǐ huan de xiāng jiāo niú nǎi
sentences.english: “Duoduo, we’re out of milk at home. Let’s go buy some milk! We’ll get your favorite banana milk.”

sentences.simplified: “多多，今天晚上有音乐会，我们去听音乐会吧！”
sentences.traditional: “多多，今天晚上有音樂會，我們去聽音樂會吧！”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō jīn tiān wǎn shang yǒu yīn yuè huì wǒ men qù tīng yīn yuè huì ba
sentences.english: “Duoduo, there is a concert tonight. Let’s go to the concert!”

sentences.simplified: 我一直说话，希望多多也说话，但是多多好像不愿意听我说话。
sentences.traditional: 我一直說話，希望多多也說話，但是多多好像不願意聽我說話。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yì zhí shuō huà xī wàng duō duō yě shuō huà dàn shì duō duō hǎo xiàng bú yuàn yì tīng wǒ shuō huà
sentences.english: I kept talking, hoping Duoduo would talk too, but Duoduo seemed unwilling to listen to me.

sentences.simplified: 她有点儿生气，对我叫：“不要说了，不要说了！”
sentences.traditional: 她有點兒生氣，對我叫：“不要說了，不要說了！”
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu diǎn'r shēng qì duì wǒ jiào bú yào shuō le bú yào shuō le
sentences.english: She was a little angry and shouted at me, “Stop it, stop it!”

sentences.simplified: 这是她第一次对成为数字人的我生气，
sentences.traditional: 這是她第一次對成為數字人的我生氣，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì tā dì yī cì duì chéng wéi shù zì rén de wǒ shēng qì
sentences.english: This was the first time she got angry at me after I became a digital human.

sentences.simplified: 我不明白她为什么生气，但网络数据告诉了我应该怎么办。
sentences.traditional: 我不明白她為什麼生氣，但網絡數據告訴了我應該怎麼辦。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù míng bai tā wèi shén me shēng qì dàn wǎng luò shù jù gào su le wǒ yīng gāi zěn me bàn
sentences.english: I didn’t understand why she was angry, but the network data told me what I should do.

sentences.pinyin: duì bu qǐ duō duō
sentences.english: “I’m sorry, Duoduo.”

sentences.pinyin: bà ba nǐ wèi shén me shuō duì bu qǐ
sentences.english: “Dad, why are you saying sorry?”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ hǎo xiàng shuō cuò huà le
sentences.english: “I think I said the wrong thing."

sentences.pinyin: bà ba nǐ shuō cuò shén me le
sentences.english: “Dad, what did you say wrong?”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào duì bu qǐ
sentences.english: “I have no idea. I’m sorry.”

sentences.simplified: 多多哭了，她看起来难过极了。
sentences.traditional: 多多哭了，她看起來難過極了。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō kū le tā kàn qǐ lái nán guò jí le
sentences.english: Duoduo cried. She looked extremely sad.

sentences.pinyin: duì bu qǐ duō duō wǒ ài nǐ
sentences.english: “I’m sorry, Duoduo. I love you.”

sentences.simplified: 多多不说话了，她关掉了对视器。
sentences.traditional: 多多不說話了，她關掉了對視器。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō bù shuō huà le tā guān diào le duì shì qì
sentences.english: Duoduo stopped talking. She turned off the viewing device.

sentence_translations: (4) I Think I Said Something Wrong
Digital humans live in the network.
If humans do not turn on the viewing device, digital humans are not able to come out and talk to humans.
So Duoduo seldom turned off the viewing device. Sometimes, she took me out. She liked to show me the outside world.
“Dad, look, these apples are so red. Let’s buy some, how about that?”
“Dad, that puppy is so beautiful. Did you see it?”
She liked to ask me questions, but sometimes she spoke too fast, and before I could answer, she had asked a second question.
Sometimes, she spoke very slowly, and even though I had already responded, it seemed like she didn’t hear me, ..
.. and I had to wait a long time before she talked to me again.
Gradually, I understood that she wasn’t really asking me questions. She just needed someone who could truly be there for her.
Once, Duoduo took me to the deep sleep center.
I looked at myself sleeping and felt very strange, as if I was separated from my body.
After watching for a while, I felt that this deep sleeping person was so strange. He seemed to be me, but also not me.
Duoduo looked at me while I was in deep sleep. Her eyes seemed to have a lot of things she wanted to say, but she didn’t speak.
On the way home, Duoduo still didn’t speak. I tried to get her to talk.
“Duoduo, don’t be sad. Dad loves you, and Dad is by your side.”
“Duoduo, you haven’t eaten anything today. Go eat the omelet rice that you like!”
“Duoduo, we’re out of milk at home. Let’s go buy some milk! We’ll get your favorite banana milk.”
“Duoduo, there is a concert tonight. Let’s go to the concert!”
I kept talking, hoping Duoduo would talk too, but Duoduo seemed unwilling to listen to me.
She was a little angry and shouted at me, “Stop it, stop it!”
This was the first time she got angry at me after I became a digital human.
I didn’t understand why she was angry, but the network data told me what I should do.
“I’m sorry, Duoduo.”
“Dad, why are you saying sorry?”
“I think I said the wrong thing."
“Dad, what did you say wrong?”
“I have no idea. I’m sorry.”
Duoduo cried. She looked extremely sad.
“I’m sorry, Duoduo. I love you.”
Duoduo stopped talking. She turned off the viewing device.
